name: Flower Dome
tagline: The only season here is Spring
description: A vast, cool-dry glasshouse filled with plants from the Mediterranean and semi-arid regions of the world. Its central field hosts ever-changing floral displays that transform through the year.
highlights: Baobabs and succulents from five continents

name: Cloud Forest
description: A towering mountain draped in orchids, ferns and pitcher plants, wrapped in cool mist and greeted by a dramatic indoor waterfall. Walkways spiral around the peak so you can explore tropical highland plant life from top to bottom.
highlights: Rare montane plants and carnivorous species

name: Floral Fantasy
tagline: The stuff dreams are made of
description: An enchanting indoor garden of suspended floral sculptures and whimsical landscapes, set beside Bayfront Plaza. Tripods and camera stands are not permitted inside.

name: Supertree Grove
tagline: Vertical gardens that light up the night
description: Home to 12 of the 18 Supertrees, towering vertical gardens clad in ferns, bromeliads and climbers. After dark the Grove becomes the stage for Garden Rhapsody, a free light-and-sound show.
highlights: Best viewed from the plaza at night

name: Garden Rhapsody
description: The Supertrees come alive with light, colour and music in this evening show at Supertree Grove. Find a spot on the plaza, or lie back on the grass, and look up.
highlights: Arrive early for a good spot

name: OCBC Skyway
description: An aerial walkway strung between the Supertrees 22 metres above the ground, with close-up views of the vertical gardens and sweeping views across the Gardens and Marina Bay.
highlights: Close-up views of the vertical gardens

name: Supertree Observatory
description: Perched at the crown of the tallest Supertree, the Observatory offers an indoor gallery and an open-air rooftop with panoramic views over the Gardens and the bay.

name: Golden Garden
tagline: A Supertree cluster in shades of gold
description: A cluster of Supertrees beside the Main Entrance, planted with yellow and golden-leaved plants that glow in the sun.

name: The Canopy
tagline: Sheltered event space by the domes
description: A covered, open-sided space between the conservatories, used for events and as a shady spot to pause.

name: Floral Clock
tagline: A working clock made of plants
description: A functioning clock whose face is planted with living plants and flowers, a favourite photo stop on the way to the conservatories.

name: Discovery
tagline: World of Plants: where it all began
description: Part of the World of Plants trail, this garden tells the story of how plant life evolved on Earth.

name: Web of Life
description: Part of the World of Plants trail, exploring how plants and animals depend on each other in the rainforest. Look out for the leafy animal topiaries.

name: Fruits and Flowers
tagline: World of Plants: a tropical orchard
description: Part of the World of Plants trail, featuring tropical fruit trees and flowering plants found across the region.

name: Understorey
tagline: World of Plants: life on the forest floor
description: Part of the World of Plants trail, revealing the shady, humid world that lives beneath the rainforest canopy.

name: World of Palms
tagline: World of Plants: palms of every shape
description: Part of the World of Plants trail, showing the remarkable variety of palms and how people use them.

name: Secret Life of Trees
tagline: World of Plants: what trees really do
description: Part of the World of Plants trail, uncovering the hidden roles trees play in the ecosystem.

name: Indian Garden
tagline: Heritage Gardens: plant stories of India
description: One of the Heritage Gardens, laid out around a traditional floral motif and planted with species significant to Indian culture.

name: Chinese Garden
tagline: Heritage Gardens: plants of Chinese culture
description: One of the Heritage Gardens, featuring plants with special meaning in Chinese culture, framed by a striking red gateway sculpture.

name: Malay Garden
description: One of the Heritage Gardens, centred on a traditional Malay house and the plants that shaped everyday kampung life.

name: Colonial Garden
tagline: Heritage Gardens: crops that built a trade
description: One of the Heritage Gardens, telling the story of the spices and cash crops that drove Singapore's colonial-era trade.

name: Planet
tagline: A giant baby that seems to float
description: Artist Marc Quinn's monumental sculpture of a sleeping infant, balanced so it appears to hover above the lawn. One of the Gardens' best-loved artworks.

name: The Meadow
tagline: A great lawn for festivals and concerts
description: A huge open lawn at the western end of the Gardens that hosts concerts, festivals and community events.

name: Serene Garden
description: A calm, minimalist garden of bamboo, water and stone, a peaceful escape from the busier parts of the Gardens.

name: Sun Pavilion
tagline: Cacti and succulents in the sun
description: A dry-landscape garden showcasing sculptural cacti and succulents from arid regions.

name: Children's Garden
description: The Far East Organization Children's Garden is a free play space with water-play areas, treehouses and trails designed for young explorers.

name: The Canyon
description: A dramatic garden of large, sculptural rocks set among plants, near the Cloud Forest.

name: Silver Garden
tagline: A Supertree cluster in silver tones
description: A cluster of Supertrees planted with silvery, pale-leaved plants that shimmer in the light.

name: Active Garden & Family Zone
tagline: Room to run, play and climb
description: The Active Garden and PropNex Family Zone offers outdoor play and activity spaces for families at the northern end of the Gardens.

name: Kingfisher Wetlands
description: A wetland habitat where you can spot birds and wildlife along a nature trail beside Kingfisher Lake.

name: Dragonfly Lake
tagline: Lakeside walks and a dragonfly bridge
description: A lake that runs along the western edge of the Gardens, crossed by Dragonfly Bridge and lined with shady boardwalks.

name: Kingfisher Lake
description: A lake at the eastern end of the Gardens, part of the natural water system that keeps the Gardens healthy.

name: Calabash Room
description: Event room.

name: Cannonball Room
description: Event room.

name: Colonnade
description: Event space.

name: Friends of the Gardens Centre
description: Membership and visitor help.

name: Bayfront Pavilion
tagline: Event pavilion by the SG50 Lattice
description: Event pavilion by the SG50 Lattice.

name: Ficus Room
description: Event room.

name: West Lawn
description: Open lawn beside Bayfront Plaza.

name: Garden Pod
description: Duplex suites built and operated by the Shipping Container Hotel, a chance to stay in the Gardens.

name: IMBA Theatre
description: A new cultural destination at Gardens by the Bay, on the West Lawn beside Bayfront Plaza. Check the official site for shows and tickets.

name: Starbucks
description: Coffee near the Main Entrance.

name: McDonald's
tagline: Quick bites near the Main Entrance
description: Quick bites near the Main Entrance.

name: Conservatory Café
description: Café by the conservatories.

name: TungLok Seafood / Douraku Sushi
description: Chinese seafood and Japanese sushi.

name: Marguerite / Hortus
description: Dining by the Flower Dome.

name: Finnwood
description: Restaurant near Cloud Forest.

name: Satay by the Bay
description: A food centre serving local hawker dishes, with charcoal-grilled satay as the star, at the eastern end of the Gardens.
highlights: Near Gardens by the Bay MRT

name: Starbucks
description: Coffee by the Waterfront Promenade.

name: Janice Wong
description: Desserts at the Supertrees.

name: Shake Shack
description: Burgers by the conservatories.

name: Hopscotch
description: Drinks near Bayfront Plaza.

name: Jurassic Nest Food Hall
description: Food hall by Supertree Grove.

name: Bayfront MRT
description: Bayfront MRT station connects to the Gardens through Bayfront Plaza and the Dragonfly Bridge.

name: Gardens by the Bay MRT
tagline: Train link at the eastern end
description: Gardens by the Bay MRT station sits at the eastern end of the Gardens, close to Satay by the Bay.

name: Main Entrance
description: The Main Entrance on Marina Gardens Drive, with the coach bay, drop-off point and parking.

name: Bayfront Plaza
description: The western gateway to the Gardens, linking Bayfront MRT and Marina Bay Sands to the Dragonfly Bridge.

name: Drop Off
tagline: Taxi and car drop-off by the Main Entrance
description: The main drop-off and pick-up point for taxis and private cars, a short walk from the Flower Dome and Supertree Grove.

name: Bayfront Plaza Car Park
description: Visitor car park near Bayfront Plaza on the west side of the Gardens. Check the official site for rates and availability.

name: Main Entrance Car Park
description: Visitor car park beside the Main Entrance off Marina Gardens Drive. Check the official site for rates and availability.

name: Coach Bay Car Park
description: Visitor car park next to the Coach Bay by the Main Entrance. Check the official site for rates and availability.

name: The Meadow Car Park
description: Visitor car park off Marina Boulevard, close to The Meadow. Check the official site for rates and availability.

name: Satay by the Bay Car Park
description: Visitor car park on the east side, close to Satay by the Bay. Check the official site for rates and availability.
